finding: The other-case test cannot fail on any CI platform: on Windows resolve() already returns the stored case, on Linux it skips
why: D-35 adds _stored_name because resolve() keeps typed case on macOS only, but CI runs ubuntu+windows, so wiring _stored_name into _preflight (publish_bug_mode.py:382) is guarded only by the direct unit test of the helper.
fix: In this test, monkeypatch mode.Path.resolve to `lambda self, strict=False: self.absolute()` (simulates macOS) before the run with `other`, so the marker assertion depends on the folder-listing lookup.
evidence: Mutant A (publish_bug_mode.py:382 reverted to `folder, name = real.parent.name, real.name`) on Windows/Python 3.14: full test file 83 passed, the only failure test_load_goes_through_tracker_api... was a missing-copy artefact. `Path('.../afk/TO-TICKET/bug-mode.md').resolve()` printed `...\afk\to-ticket\BUG-MODE.md`. A probe with resolve patched to absolute() passes on head and kills mutant A: `assert 'afk-evidence export_description-e09bf8f8 ticket' in '...afk-evidence export_description-4c46329d ticket'`. tests.yml matrix: `ubuntu-latest`, `windows-latest`.

finding: No test covers _stored_name's no-match fallthrough when the folder exists but lists no matching entry
why: Every assertion either finds a match or hits the scandir OSError branch, so the final `return path.name` (publish_bug_mode.py:594) can change without any test noticing.
evidence: Mutant B (line 594 `return path.name` -> `return names[0] if names else path.name`): `-k "description or stored_name"` 11 passed.

finding: _stored_name's fallback matches by same file (inode), so a hard-linked sibling can be returned instead of the case-variant name, giving one file two work ids
why: When the typed name is not listed (case-blind FS where resolve() keeps typed case, i.e. macOS per D-35), the first listed entry that is the same file wins, and a hard link with a different name is the same file, so `A.md` can hash as `0.md` while `a.md` hashes as `a.md` - the exact one-file-two-ids outcome D-35 says it closes.
fix: Before the samefile loop, prefer a listed name whose casefold()/unicodedata NFC form equals path.name's; use samefile only as the last resort.
evidence: Code: `for name in names: ... if os.path.samefile(path.parent / name, path): return name`. Fake run (Windows, calling _stored_name directly to stand in for macOS where resolve() keeps typed case): folder holds `a.md` and hard link `0.md`; `_stored_name(d/'a.md') -> a.md`, `_stored_name(d/'A.md') -> 0.md`. On Windows _preflight is shielded because `(d/'A.md').resolve()` already yields `a.md`.
